name: marketing-polls
title: Polls
description: Interactive single-question, multiple-choice, and rating poll components for gathering audience feedback, running surveys, and engaging visitors on marketing websites and content pages.
useWhen: Collecting audience opinion with a quick single-question poll embedded in a blog post or content page.
Running a multi-option survey to understand user preferences on a product page.
Capturing a rating (1–5 stars or NPS score) at the end of an article or resource.
avoidWhen: Detailed feedback collection with open-text responses is needed — use a contact form or embedded survey tool.
Results need real-time aggregation and reporting — these components are presentational and require backend integration.
The poll interferes with the primary conversion goal of the page — use sparingly in high-conversion contexts.
responsiveBehavior: Poll options stack vertically on all screen sizes. Rating polls display star or score buttons in a row that wraps gracefully on small screens.
accessibility: Poll questions must use a <fieldset> and <legend> for the question text; each option uses a radio or checkbox with a linked <label>.
Rating inputs must have aria-label indicating both the rating value and the maximum (e.g., '4 out of 5 stars').
Results bars shown after voting must have text alternatives conveying the percentage, not just visual fill.

variants.title: Single question poll
variants.description: Binary or short-option radio poll with a single question and two to four answer choices — for quick audience opinion checks embedded in content.
accessibility: <fieldset>/<legend> wraps the question; each radio option has a linked <label>.

variants.title: Single question poll (Dark)
variants.description: Single-question radio poll adapted for dark marketing page surfaces.
accessibility: Radio indicators and option labels must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark poll backgrounds.

variants.title: Multiple choice survey
variants.description: Checkbox-based multi-select survey allowing visitors to choose multiple applicable answers — for preference surveys and feature prioritization.
accessibility: <fieldset>/<legend> wraps the question; each checkbox has a linked <label>; submit button announces action.

variants.title: Multiple choice survey (Dark)
variants.description: Multi-select checkbox survey adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Checkbox indicators and option labels must meet contrast requirements on dark survey backgrounds.

variants.title: Rating poll
variants.description: Star or numeric rating poll for collecting satisfaction scores, NPS, or product ratings inline within content pages.
accessibility: Rating inputs use radio buttons; each rating option has aria-label indicating its value out of the maximum.

variants.title: Rating poll (Dark)
variants.description: Star/numeric rating poll adapted for dark marketing page surfaces.
accessibility: Rating indicators and labels must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark poll backgrounds.
